Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
I send the two vols of [Bishop Patteson](../books.html#102) by train today, having done all the abridging that I think they will bear, I believe it is about 100pp in each volume, and a good many lines besides so that with smaller type and thinner paper I think it will be reduced enough.

Since I began this has come the enquiry after the author of the Children of the Forest or the Three Knights.[^1] I cannot recollect anything about her, nor that the story of that title has been in the Monthly Packet

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: ‘The Children in the Forest’, a translation from the German by C.P., had appeared in MP (November 1856), 376-384.
